description: Determine if the hardcore death mode is enabled.
sslmDescription: Multiply the amount of stomach saturation lost per second. Minimum of 1.
drawbackSeverityDescription: Multiply the severity of the drawback effect.
fatGainLossDescription: Base rate muliplier for how fat is gained and lost.
strainGainLossDescription: Base rate muliplier for how strain on the stomach is measured.
difficultyDescription: Set the difficulty of the mod. Valid values are easy, normal, and hard.
imDescription: Toggle on/off the immersive messages that appear when using the mod.
barDescription: Change how the bar appears when using the mod. Enabling the bar turns off immersive messages.
overStuffedDescription: Delay in milliseconds before the movement speed debuff from being overstuffed fades. (default 1 minute)
overstuffedthdescription: Percentage of stomach saturation needed to be overstuffed. (default 90%)
